_note: House styles. One entry = one look for cards, name tag, labels, the ground of every shot and the burned subtitles. BLUEPRINT, CHALK and POSTER are examples to choose from or copy; add your own entry (Claude does this with you at setup) and name it in studio.toml [style] house. ground: grid | dust | flat | paper. plate (name tag): bar | outline | chalk | block | card. titleFont: sans | label | mono | hand. Colours are #RRGGBB.

BLUEPRINT.label: Blueprint: a technical drawing. Deep blue sheet with a fine grid, thin pale lines, cyan for what is pointed at, monospace labels.

CHALK.label: Chalkboard: a teacher at the board. Dark green board with chalk dust, soft white strokes, yellow and pink chalk for emphasis, handwritten labels.

POSTER.label: Poster: flat editorial graphics. Off-white ground, big bold type, solid colour blocks, one vermilion accent and a deep blue.
